From [[Brandon Sanderson]]'s [http://www.brandonsanderson.com/blog/892/Last-chance-to-vote-for-the-David-Gemmell-Legend-Award website]:

I've mentioned a few times that both WARBREAKER and THE GATHERING STORM are among five nominees for the [http://gemmellaward.com/page/vote-for-the-legend-here David Gemmell Legend Award]. Well, voting on the award ends on Monday May 31st. Since the award is based in the UK, I assume the voting closes at midnight UK time, which is 5:00 or maybe 6:00 p.m. Mountain time (depending on whether daylight saving time is taken into account).

If you're struggling to pick between the two books, I recommend THE GATHERING STORM since I feel it's more in the spirit of Mr. Gemmell's work. Plus, you know, Robert Jordan collected weapons, and I think an award that's a battleaxe would be right up his alley. [http://gemmellaward.com/page/vote-for-the-legend-here So go vote!] (Assuming you want either book to win.)
